video.description:
Learn to explain how to give settings starting values, share them and react when they change: Default Registration, UserDefaults Suite & didChangeNotification, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Default Registration - A way to set starting values for keys, which the app uses until the user saves a new value.
UserDefaults Suite - A named group of saved settings, kept apart from the standard settings or shared with other targets.
didChangeNotification - The notification that UserDefaults posts when a saved setting changes, so your app can react.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Default Registration, UserDefaults Suite & didChangeNotification in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Default Registration, UserDefaults Suite, didChangeNotification 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Default Registration - A way to set starting values for keys, which the app uses until the user saves a new value.
한국어: Default Registration: 사용자가 새 값을 저장하기 전까지 앱이 쓰는 키의 시작 값을 정하는 방법

UserDefaults Suite - A named group of saved settings, kept apart from the standard settings or shared with other targets.
한국어: UserDefaults Suite: 표준 설정과 따로 보관하거나 다른 타깃과 공유하는, 이름이 붙은 저장 설정 묶음

didChangeNotification - The notification that UserDefaults posts when a saved setting changes, so your app can react.
한국어: didChangeNotification: 저장된 설정이 바뀔 때 UserDefaults가 보내는 알림으로, 앱이 이에 반응할 수 있다

landscape.hook: Can you explain Default Registration, UserDefaults Suite and didChangeNotification in English?

dialogue.title: Zero on a fresh install

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the font size setting is zero on a fresh install. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nothing is saved yet, so `integer` returns zero. Use default registration.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You register starting values, like `size` is 16. The app uses them until the user saves a new one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the widget needs to read the same settings.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then create a UserDefaults suite. A UserDefaults suite is a named group of settings.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So `d` is a separate group, not the standard one?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. You can share a UserDefaults suite with other targets.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if one screen changes a setting and another screen must react?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Observe didChangeNotification. UserDefaults posts it when a saved setting changes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So we reload the screen when didChangeNotification arrives?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Reload the UI there, and keep the default registration at launch.

dialogue.code:
import Foundation
let d = UserDefaults(suiteName: "app.x")!
d.register(defaults: ["size": 16])
print(d.integer(forKey: "size"))
